comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a robot gripper stop; PR-2181 probes a burger through its side to take a central temperature reading.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a driver and jam-nut wrench under reaction torque; PR-2181 stabilizes a patty with a turner while controlling probe entry angle and depth.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained 90° motion over three cycles; PR-2181 requires a valid side entry, central one-second reading, limited patty motion, withdrawal, and tool replacement.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization is generic; probe insertion and measurement do not test setting preservation under locking torque.
